race.description: Sctc Horse Of The Year - Written By Lucy Mdn Hcp
race.comment: ZINGER (6) excellent debut on the soft (7) surface with a narrow second over 1000m at Wyong in a very strong contest. Handy draw will assist and she can prove too good for these. MACHRIHANISH (10) third-up for this and struggling to draw a good barrier this time in. Launched late from back in the field with an encouraging third over 1100m at Hawkesbury. Will drift back again and relish the fast tempo. Top-three contender. LEGASELLI (8) nice filly resuming. Failed to come up in her first prep when outclassed in the G2 Reisling and G3 Baillieu. Primed with the two sharp trials and no surprise to see her finish over the top of these. BRIGHT PROMISE (7) returns from a lengthy spell. Looks to have strengthened over the break judging by her two good trials. Stays in the mix.
